text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
S-So many...! I must admit, I 
underestimated you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I accept this duty with full sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
When studying in the dorm room, place it 
on the desk. When going to sleep, take it 
into bed with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Master and disciple, Trainer and 
Umamusume— I shall forge a bond akin to 
parent and child, osu!"
